capabilities: Import notes from JSON files, CSV files, or URLs
Generate note content from Handlebars templates
Build note names from data fields or inline JavaScript
Run batch passes over one source file with varying parameters
Add custom Handlebars helpers from a JavaScript file
extras: README documents limits: only the first JSON object is read (so full Foundry VTT db files are not supported), templates referencing non-simple fields produce [object Object], and CSV column names must be valid Handlebars identifiers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate many notes at once from structured JSON or CSV data.
summary: Bulk note importer that creates one note per record from JSON or CSV data using a Handlebars template file.
